name: Mezo USD
oneLiner: MUSD is Mezo's BTC-only overcollateralized stablecoin on Mezo's Bitcoin L2, minted at 110% minimum against native and wrapped BTC via Liquity v1.
pegMechanism: BTC-only overcollateralized CDP with direct $1 BTC redemption; operates on Mezo (Bitcoin L2, not Ethereum or a Stage 1 L2)

mintAuthority.summary: MUSD is primarily minted on Mezo through a BTC-only overcollateralized CDP/Liquity-style borrower path; the Ethereum token/bridge surface has owner-managed mintList entries, with the meaningful active Ethereum minter identified as a Wormhole NTT manager owned by a 5/9 Safe.

controls.evidence: Official Mezo docs describe MUSD as a BTC-only overcollateralized stablecoin minted by borrowing against BTC collateral, not primarily as an Ethereum bridge/OFT synthetic.

review.evidence: Official Mezo docs describe core Mezo-side MUSD minting through a BTC-only overcollateralized borrower/CDP flow. Ethereum token reads identify owner-managed mintList authority, a 5/9 Safe owner, and a Wormhole NTT manager as the meaningful active Ethereum mint/bridge route.
unresolvedQuestions: Decode Mezo-side borrower/CDP contract admin and collateral parameter authority.

Active mintList entries 0x52b952d9e77fc89c7a0ab5b766e6560df778c35a and 0xe9c3d269d259d3a336147714dca60e3ff639079a are noOp contracts; do not classify them as operational minters without explanation from Mezo.
